subject: Valencia Health SIG intake — scheduling, CAIQ, and sample logs
body:
From: Lisa Chang <lisa.chang@valenciahealth.com>
To: priyom_das@redwoodinference.com
Cc: security@valenciahealth.com, mark.bennett@valenciahealth.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:15:00 -0500
Subject: Redwood SIG intake — quick scheduling request

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for agreeing to help us with the SIG/CAIQ intake. We need to kick off the questionnaire review and confirm owners for evidence. Can you and your team do a 45-minute call this week? Our preference is Thursday morning ET (9–11am). On the call we want to:
- Confirm which CAIQ sections you will complete vs. which require additional info
- Identify evidence owners and delivery dates
- Request a small set of logs (auth & audit) and a network diagram sample

Please let us know availability and any pre-read we should expect.

—Lisa
Lisa Chang
Head of Information Security
Valencia Health

-----
From: priyom_das@redwoodinference.com
To: Lisa Chang <lisa.chang@valenciahealth.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com, david_kim@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood SIG intake — quick scheduling request

Hi Lisa — thanks for the note and context. Thursday morning ET works for us; we can do 9:30–10:15am ET to keep it tight. Proposed agenda (45 min):
1) 10m: Introductions + scope confirmation (SIG/CAIQ + any custom questions)
2) 15m: CAIQ owner mapping (we'll indicate items we can pre-fill)
3) 10m: Evidence cadence — who owns logs/diagrams and delivery dates
4) 10m: Action log and next steps (DocuSign/Drive links)

Pre-reads from our side: we will upload a partially completed CAIQ (answers for infra and hosting questions) and a README describing log slices we can share.

Attaching the file list we'll bring to the call. If that time is OK I'll send a calendar invite and a short HubSpot note linking VAL-2391.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Security Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
pri yom_das@redwoodinference.com

Attachments (referenced): redwood_caiq_filled_partial.xlsx, redwood_log_sample_README.txt

-----
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: priyom_das@redwoodinference.com
Cc: david_kim@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood SIG intake — quick scheduling request

Looping in a couple of notes ahead of the call:
- I'll own CAIQ sections: Asset Management, Vendor Management, and Change Control.
- David, can you confirm whether we can share a 7-day auth/audit log sample (redacted) and the network diagram? Valencia asked for sample logs; we should be explicit about retention and redaction.

Also flagging two potential blockers to check before the call:
1) If Valencia requires an unredacted user-id column we need their legal ok (PII concern).
2) If they need a long retention window for audit logs we should propose an export instead of changing retention.

Thanks — I'll jump on the call Thursday.

—Grace
Grace O'Connor
Customer Security Lead | Redwood Inference

-----
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: priyom_das@redwoodinference.com, grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 10:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood SIG intake — quick scheduling request

Confirmed: we can provide a 7-day redacted auth and audit log sample (S3 presigned, gzipped). The sample will have user IDs hashed and IPs masked; timestamps preserved. I'll also attach an updated network diagram (v2) showing public/private subnets and our egress controls. Estimated delivery: within 48 hours after the call.

Notes on CAIQ: we will fill the infrastructure/hosting sections ahead of the call but will leave application-level configs for the Valencia app team to confirm.

—David
David Kim
Infra Security Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachments (to be uploaded post-call): redwood_network_diagram_v2.pdf

-----
From: Lisa Chang <lisa.chang@valenciahealth.com>
To: priyom_das@redwoodinference.com
Cc: mark.bennett@valenciahealth.com, security@valenciahealth.com
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 12:42:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Redwood SIG intake — quick scheduling request

Thanks all — 9:30am ET Thursday confirmed. A few quick items before we meet:
- We prefer the CAIQ answers in the CAIQ XLSX template if possible.
- For logs, redacted user IDs are fine; we just need to validate retention and format.
- Can you add a short note in the CAIQ for any sections where you mark "partial" and list the owner who will complete it?

I'll circulate a calendar invite (Valencia/Redwood SIG intake). Looking forward to the call.

Best,
—Lisa

On Thu, Dec 3, 2026 at 09:50 AM -0800 priyom_das@redwoodinference.com wrote:
> Calendar invite sent for Thu 2026-12-03 09:30am ET. Drive folder link: https://drive.re/valencia/sig/2026-12-intake
>
> Quick pre-call checklist:
> - Redwood: partial CAIQ upload + README; network diagram v2; sample log README
> - Valencia: list of custom questions and owners (if any)
>
> See you on the call — Priyom
